items.name: Expedition Invitation
items.text: To the bearer: report to Maruut Stonebinder at the expedition camp on the eastern approach to the Charred Vale. We need someone who can look beyond uniforms. Our people are missing, and the stones have begun to speak.
items.description: The expedition seal admits its bearer to Maruut's camp.

items.name: Missing Travelers Log
items.text: Mira, Dorn and Teren departed with surveying tools. Their final note describes fresh ash beside intact trees, bootprints moving toward the old valley, and a stone marker scratched with a spiral. They did not return.
items.description: The final entries name three surveyors who never returned.

items.name: Coded Twilight Orders
items.text: Collect the surveyors alive. Keep the commander apart from the other prisoners. The buyer has no use for broken tools. Rotate the watch at the marked post. The spiral is our sign.
items.description: A spiral seal marks the cult's instructions.

items.name: Damaged Ward Rubbing
items.text: Three impressions reveal the same spiral cut across older runes. The fractures are too regular to be weathering. Someone is teaching the stone a different command.
items.description: Three ward tracings reveal the same spiral beneath the ash.

items.name: Ward Tracing Kit
items.description: Use on a ward stone. Maruut can replace a lost kit.

items.name: Vale Expedition Signet of Might
items.description: A signet of the Vale expedition, given for bringing its missing people home.

quests.title: An Unusual Commission
quests.description: The expedition in Stonetalon is accepting help from anyone willing to put missing travelers before old quarrels. Take this invitation to Maruut Stonebinder. His camp is on the eastern approach to the Charred Vale.
quests.objectives: Follow the old road toward the Charred Vale and look for the expedition's blue-clad stonebinder.
quests.completion: You came. Good. Three of our people are overdue, and the trail is beginning to give answers I do not like.
quests.request_text: Do you carry the expedition's invitation?
quests.return_text: Speak with Maruut Stonebinder at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: An Unusual Commission
quests.description: Maruut Stonebinder needs help in Stonetalon. Three surveyors have vanished near the Charred Vale. This is an expedition, not a border dispute. Take this invitation to his neutral camp on the valley's eastern approach.
quests.objectives: Look for the expedition camp above the Charred Vale. Maruut will recognize the invitation.
quests.completion: You came. Good. Three of our people are overdue, and the trail is beginning to give answers I do not like.
quests.request_text: Let me see the invitation before we begin.
quests.return_text: Speak with Maruut Stonebinder at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: Travelers Who Never Arrived
quests.description: Mira, Dorn and Teren were inspecting old trail stones. Their abandoned wagon is beside our camp. Search it for the travelers' log. Leave what supplies remain for the survivors.
quests.objectives: Inspect the abandoned wagon above camp and recover its log.
quests.completion: The spiral again. It was carved into stone that had stood quietly for generations. Our scout has found fresh tracks leading into the valley.
quests.request_text: Did anything survive in the wagon's strongbox?
quests.return_text: Speak with Maruut Stonebinder at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: Follow the Ash
quests.description: Inspect the surveyors' discarded supplies, journal and map on the eastern approaches. Defeat the six Twilight scouts watching that route and recover their orders. The last clue leads to the roadside prisoners; keep clear of the ritual compound deeper in the Vale.
quests.objectives: Inspect all three discarded survey clues, defeat six Twilight Scouts and recover their coded orders.
quests.completion: Prisoners, a separate commander, and a watch rotation. Those were not bandits taking whatever they could carry. Someone organized this.
quests.request_text: Show me the orders, and tell me what you found at all three survey clues.
quests.return_text: Speak with the Expedition Scout at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: Bring Them Home
quests.description: Mira, Dorn and Teren are held at a small roadside guard camp southeast of our expedition, on the eastern side of the Charred Vale. This is separate from the cult's ritual compound deeper in the valley. Clear the guards and speak to each surveyor, then accompany them back to our camp. Nobody gets left behind.
quests.objectives: Speak to Mira, Dorn and Teren and accompany each surveyor to the expedition camp.
quests.completion: All three are safe. They remember a spiral carved into the ward stones and a prisoner called Shadowsong. Maruut needs to hear this.
quests.request_text: Mira, Dorn and Teren are still missing. Have all three reached our banner?
quests.return_text: Speak with the Expedition Scout at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: A Stone That Should Be Quiet
quests.description: The cult has cut three older ward stones across the Charred Vale: one on the northwestern rise, one on the southwestern valley floor, and one along the eastern rim. Twilight defenders watch each stone. Clear them, then use this tracing kit on each distinct ward and bring me the complete rubbing.
quests.objectives: Trace all three ward stones and recover a complete rubbing. I can replace a lost kit.
quests.completion: Those are deliberate cuts. The new spiral interrupts the old pattern at exactly the points it needs. Ortell knows the people who use that sign.
quests.request_text: Have you traced all three ward stones? I need the complete rubbing.
quests.return_text: Speak with Maruut Stonebinder at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: The Same Hand
quests.description: Ortell once knew the Twilight's Hammer from the inside. He is helping us now. Speak with him here in camp and compare the deposited orders with the ward rubbing. You do not need to carry those papers back and forth; I have sent him copies.
quests.objectives: Ask Ortell to compare the orders and the rubbing.
quests.completion: The hand that wrote the orders also marked the stone. That spiral is an instruction, not a decoration. We must find out what else they intend to break.
quests.request_text: Ortell can compare the evidence we have already deposited. What did he find?
quests.return_text: Speak with Elementalist Ortell at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: A Captive Commander
quests.description: The surveyors recognized the commander's name: Jarod Shadowsong. He is held at the altar in the cult's ritual compound, well away from the roadside prisoners. Take this spyglass to our scout's banner on the rise northwest of the altar. Use it there and watch quietly from outside the camp. We need to know he is alive before planning his rescue.
quests.objectives: Use the supplied spyglass beside the lookout banner northwest of the ritual camp and confirm Jarod is alive.
quests.completion: He is alive. The guards and the sacrifice make a direct charge hopeless. We will borrow a recruit's identity and work our way into the inner circle. Return to me at level 25 for Signed in Blood. Take this signet for the surveyors you brought home.
quests.request_text: Did you see Jarod clearly? Keep your voice low.
quests.return_text: Speak with Elementalist Ortell at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

quests.title: The Name on the Papers
quests.description: This earlier expedition briefing has been replaced by the direct handoff to Signed in Blood. If it remains in your log, speak with Ortell at the expedition camp to settle the report and continue. You do not need to revisit the lookout.
quests.objectives: Speak with Ortell at the expedition camp to settle the earlier briefing.
quests.completion: Two short knocks, then a pause. If the wrong person answers, you walk away. You have earned this signet, and the expedition's trust. Speak with me again once you reach level twenty-five; entering the cult will require a steadier hand.
quests.request_text: Have you watched the recruit finish his circuit and agreed our signal?
quests.return_text: Speak with Elementalist Ortell at the expedition camp in the eastern Charred Vale.

npc_texts.NPC_MARUUT: Old stones do not start speaking without a reason. Help us find our missing people, and we will learn who disturbed them.
npc_texts.NPC_ORTELL: The Twilight's Hammer rewards certainty. Inside their camps, doubt is best kept behind your teeth.
npc_texts.NPC_SCOUT: Fresh ash, bootprints, and a trail nobody wants to explain. Stay alert on the descent.
npc_texts.NPC_COURIER_A: A neutral expedition needs someone who can see past the color of a banner.
npc_texts.NPC_COURIER_H: The invitation is for a willing traveler. The missing people need help, not another argument about borders.
npc_texts.NPC_CAPTIVE_A: The cult took our notes and put us under guard. If the path is clear, I can walk.
npc_texts.NPC_CAPTIVE_B: The cult took our notes and put us under guard. If the path is clear, I can walk.
npc_texts.NPC_CAPTIVE_C: The cult took our notes and put us under guard. If the path is clear, I can walk.

notes: Native-race clothes are Wrath approximations, not claimed exact later costumes.
No item/model/map client patch is required.
The Chapter 1 SQL remains independently installable. Chapter 2 adds Signed in Blood (900200) to the same Ortell, requiring reward of 900108 and level 25.
Shared saved captives occupy a separate roadside guard camp; successful escorts reset after five minutes for other players.
Ward stones are spread across the Vale with two Twilight defenders at each. Observation uses a supplied spyglass from the northwestern rise; decorative scenery is unselectable.
The legacy Name on the Papers quest is not offered to new players; existing holders finish locally with Ortell. Chapter 2 follows rewarded commander observation directly.
